name: Distributed 3D Gaussian Splatting
aliases: Distributed 3D Gaussian Splatting for Scientific Visualization
definition: A multi-GPU extension of the 3D-GS pipeline for scientific visualization that distributes optimization across GPUs to enable scalable processing of large datasets exceeding single-GPU memory capacity.
summary: Distributed 3D Gaussian Splatting is a multi-GPU extension of 3D-GS that distributes Gaussian parameters across workers to overcome single-GPU memory bottlenecks during optimization of large scientific datasets.
